name: AI-C1: Replace TanStack AI with Pi RPC Client
description: Remove @tanstack/ai and @tanstack/ai-openai deps, add Pi RPC subprocess client to agent-service
steps: Remove @tanstack/ai and @tanstack/ai-openai from packages/server/package.json
Remove packages/server/src/agent/agent-tools.ts (TanStack toolDefinition wrappers no longer needed)
Create packages/server/src/agent/pi-rpc-client.ts — spawns `pi --mode rpc --no-session` as child process, sends/receives JSON lines over stdin/stdout
PiRpcClient class: constructor takes { provider?, model? }, exposes send(command), onEvent(callback), prompt(message), abort(), destroy()
Internally: readline on stdout, parse JSON lines, route to event callbacks
Handle process lifecycle: spawn on first use, kill on destroy, restart on crash
Run bun run typecheck to verify no dangling TanStack imports

name: AI-C2: Schema — Replace TanStack Tool JSON Schemas with Plain Tool Descriptions
description: Convert AI tool schemas from @valibot/to-json-schema (TanStack format) to plain string descriptions for Pi system prompt
steps: Remove toStandardJsonSchema imports and all tool JSON schema exports (addSlideInputSchema, removeSlideInputSchema, etc.) from packages/schema/src/ai-commands.ts
Remove @valibot/to-json-schema from packages/schema/package.json if only used here (check first)
Keep SlideCommandSchema and SlideCommand type — these are the structured command types the AI should output

Add new export: SLIDE_TOOL_DESCRIPTIONS — a plain string constant describing available tools, their parameters, and expected JSON output format (SlideCommand). This will be injected into the Pi system prompt
Run bun run typecheck in packages/schema
dependencies: AI-C1: Replace TanStack AI with Pi RPC Client

name: AI-C3: Rewrite agent-service — Effect-based Command Executor
description: Rewrite agent-service to parse SlideCommand JSON from Pi agent responses and execute via Effect SlideService
steps: Rewrite packages/server/src/agent/agent-service.ts
Remove all TanStack tool server handlers (addSlideDef.server, etc.)
Create parseSlideCommand(text: string): SlideCommand | null — extracts JSON from agent text response, validates against SlideCommandSchema using valibot parse
Create executeSlideCommand(command: SlideCommand): Effect<ServerDeckState, SlideError, SlideService> — pattern match on command.type, delegate to SlideService methods
Keep BroadcastFn type and broadcast-after-execution pattern
Keep runServiceEffect helper, Sentry tracing spans (agent.tool.*), and captureEffectError
Run bun run typecheck
dependencies: AI-C2: Schema — Replace TanStack Tool JSON Schemas with Plain Tool Descriptions

name: AI-C4: Rewrite agent-controller — Pi RPC Integration
description: Replace TanStack AI chat() streaming with Pi RPC subprocess prompt/event flow
steps: Rewrite packages/server/src/agent/agent-controller.ts
Remove all TanStack AI imports (chat, toServerSentEventsResponse, maxIterations, createOpenaiChat)
Replace openaiApiKey config check with pi binary availability check (which pi)
POST /agent/chat handler: create or reuse PiRpcClient instance (one per server lifetime, or pool by deckId)
Build system prompt with SLIDE_TOOL_DESCRIPTIONS from schema + deck context
On first prompt: send set_model if configured, then prompt with system context + user message
Stream Pi events (message_update text_delta) back to client as SSE (same interface the frontend expects)
On agent_end: extract last assistant text, run parseSlideCommand, if valid execute via executeSlideCommand + broadcast
Keep Sentry span wrapping (agent.chat)
Run bun run typecheck
dependencies: AI-C3: Rewrite agent-service — Effect-based Command Executor

name: AI-C5: Config — Replace OpenAI Key with Pi Agent Config
description: Update AppConfig to support Pi agent provider/model instead of OpenAI API key
steps: Update packages/server/src/config/app-config.ts
Remove openaiApiKey field from AppConfig interface
Add piProvider: Option<string> (env PI_PROVIDER, default none — uses pi default)
Add piModel: Option<string> (env PI_MODEL, default none — uses pi default)
Update loadAppConfig Effect.gen to load new config fields
Update agent-controller.ts to use new config fields when initializing PiRpcClient
Run bun run typecheck
dependencies: AI-C4: Rewrite agent-controller — Pi RPC Integration

name: AI-C6: Update AGENTS.md and Remove @valibot/to-json-schema
description: Update server AGENTS.md to reflect Pi RPC architecture, clean up unused deps
steps: Update packages/server/AGENTS.md: replace TanStack AI references with Pi RPC integration description
Update section 7 (AI Agent Integration) to describe Pi subprocess model
Update section 8 (Agent Flow): Client → POST /agent/chat → Pi RPC subprocess → structured SlideCommand → SlideService → broadcast
Remove @valibot/to-json-schema from packages/server/package.json if still present
Remove @tanstack/ai and @tanstack/ai-openai from package.json if not already removed
Run bun install to clean lockfile
Run bun run typecheck && bun run lint
dependencies: AI-C5: Config — Replace OpenAI Key with Pi Agent Config

name: AI-C7: Tests — Pi RPC Client and Command Executor
description: Add unit tests for Pi RPC client and SlideCommand parsing/execution
steps: Create packages/server/test/agent/pi-rpc-client.test.ts — test constructor, onEvent, destroy, isAlive lifecycle
Rewrite packages/server/test/agent/agent-service.test.ts — test parseSlideCommands with valid/invalid JSON, test executeSlideCommands for each command type
Rewrite packages/server/test/agent/agent-controller.test.ts — test endpoint structure, request validation, SSE response
Fix test/helpers.ts — remove openaiApiKey, add piProvider/piModel
Fix pi-rpc-client.ts — export PiRpcEvent interface
Run bun test test/ and verify all pass
